tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List the bicycle.guide registry — every guide's home, status, access, standard, syndication and grounding, plus the distribution roll-up (including guides homed to a property with no rendering surface).

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Get one guide's registry row by slug, with its artifact + routing-surface status.

tools.name: list_taxonomy
tools.description: Get the bicycle.guide vocabulary — domains, shelves (with live guide counts), series, personas, guide_types, and the classification conventions (pillar/spoke, discriminant home, bicycle-guide-serves-all) as machine-readable data rather than prose.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Traverse the capability spine joining books, guides (capability packages), KSAO-grade elements and jobs. Use min_guides=2 for the cross-cutting capabilities that span many guides, role=<role> for what a job requires, capability_detail=<slug> for one package with its elements and books hydrated. ksao

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search published guides by topic. Returns matches, or a structured refusal with the nearest owned guides and the missing topic. No model call. Filter by persona or category.

tools.name: list_disagreements
tools.description: Where does the field disagree? Returns cross-book tension names and the books on each pole (title, author, library_id) plus the guide URL. Filter by slug, persona, or category. Names and provenance only — no passages.

tools.name: list_conditions
tools.description: List organizational conditions (identity, label, guide count, causal-role counts). Filter by draft domain, subdomain, or causal_role (driver|mediator|outcome). Names and counts only — no addresses, no passages.

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Get one Answer — question, grounded answer, visible citations — by id or slug, in the Answer contract v0 shape (ANSWERS-PROGRAM.md). Read-only. Returns null if not found.

tools.name: list_answers
tools.description: List Answers (contract v0), paginated with an opaque cursor. Read-only.

tools.name: search_answers
tools.description: Search Answers by free-text query over question/answer text. Returns contract v0 records. Read-only.
